note: Upgrade Roadmap 2. References and explicit game assumptions are recorded in each row. Existing rows are unchanged.

resources.name: Potable water storage
resources.note: Safe-water tank volume only; LL-33 separate pools.

systems.name: Spring Box with Gravity Line
systems.description: Pipes untreated water from a nearby site spring; no fetching trip.
systems.notes: Requires an in-season spring within 50 ft. Nominal 25 gal/day, capped by node availability and drought. https://extension.psu.edu/spring-development-and-protection Costs, labor, capacities and throughput are experimental game balance, not engineering specifications.

systems.name: First-Flush Diverter
systems.description: Diverts dirty roof runoff before collection; reduces the labor of rainwater filtering.
systems.notes: With storage pools: discard 5% of captured rainwater; 25% less filter labor with yesterday's working diverter. Does not make water potable. https://www.rainharvest.com/info/rainharvesting/RainHarvesting-Delta-First-Flush-Post-Wall-Installation-Guide.pdf Costs, labor, capacities and throughput are experimental game balance, not engineering specifications.

systems.name: Potable Water Tank (100 gal)
systems.description: A covered container for treated drinking water only.
systems.notes: LL-33 separate storage pools required; no raw-water capacity or treatment. Assumed indoor/frost-protected. Costs, labor, capacities and throughput are experimental game balance, not engineering specifications.

systems.name: Heat-Traced Water Tank (100 gal)
systems.description: An outdoor raw-water tank with an installed thermostatic heat trace.
systems.notes: LL-33 freezing model: automatic heating needs 0.0008 kWh per gallon per freezing degree-day; without power it freezes. Costs, labor, capacities and throughput are experimental game balance, not engineering specifications.

systems.name: Water Test Kit
systems.description: Checks untreated sources and warns that raw water still needs treatment.
systems.notes: LL-38 risk gate: measured upkeep and reagent spending enable a precautionary contamination warning; no invented pathogen measurement. https://extension.psu.edu/spring-development-and-protection Costs, labor, capacities and throughput are experimental game balance, not engineering specifications.
